visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Old Characters Show After the Result
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Removing the spaces from "hello big world" should print hellobigworld, but the program prints hellobigworldld.

solution.explanation: Compacting the characters moves them forward but leaves the old tail of the string behind them. Without a new '\0' at the write position printf keeps reading the stale characters up to the original end.
